name: robomimic
description: A benchmark and collection of demonstration datasets for learning from human and scripted demonstrations in robot manipulation. The datasets support imitation learning and offline reinforcement learning; robomimic is distinct from environment and task suites such as BabyAI, NetHack, SMAC, Meta-World, and VIMA.
citation: Mandlekar, A., Xu, D., Wong, J., et al. (2021). What Matters in Learning from Offline Human Demonstrations for Robot Manipulation. Proceedings of the 5th Conference on Robot Learning, PMLR 164, 1678–1690. https://proceedings.mlr.press/v164/mandlekar22a.html
